Title: 2024-02-06 Live Patch
Subtitle: === General ===
CleanedNotes:
=== General ===
[Updates]
  Experience:
  • Experience gained by enemy Heroes added as floating combat text.
[Bug Fixes]
  • Fixed an anchor offset on Hero Select display.
  • Fixed an issue that caused Shielding to not be displayed correctly in the Death Recap.
  • Fixed an issue that caused Heroes who can use Basic Attacks while moving to show a red mark instead of a green mark on the ground.
  • Fixed an issue that caused place of death to reveal into nearby shrubs.
  • Fixed an issue that caused player-located cooldowns to continue refreshing after a Core is destroyed.
  • Fixed an issue that caused the event count in the Death Recap to update for all players when a new Death Recap is created for any player.

=== Battlegrounds: Alterac Pass ===
[Bug Fixes]
  • Fixed an issue that caused Gnolls to reduce the Armor of enemies before damage was dealt.

=== Battlegrounds: Blackheart's Bay ===
[Updates]
  Objective:
  • Doubloons
    • They now feature a warning indicator at their landing location.

=== Battlegrounds: Braxis Holdout ===
[Bug Fixes]
  • Fixed an issue that caused Hellbats to reduce the Armor of enemies before damage was dealt.

=== Battlegrounds: Haunted Mines ===
[Bug Fixes]
  • Fixed an issue that caused the area warning indicator for Sapper's Basic Attacks to persist after a Basic Attack has landed.

=== Battlegrounds: Towers of Doom ===
[Bug Fixes]
  • Fixed an issue that caused the area warning indicator for Sapper's Basic Attacks to persist after a Basic Attack has landed.

=== Battlegrounds: Warhead Junction ===
[Bug Fixes]
  • Fixed an issue that caused Hellbats to reduce the Armor of enemies before damage was dealt.

=== Heroes: Abathur ===
[Bug Fixes]
  • Evolve Monstrosity Stacks are now a Heroic Quest. Players will now be able to see how many stacks the Monstrosity has on the scoreboard, and when it has full stacks, it will display a quest complete indicator.
  • Toxic Nest is no longer triggered by Invulnerable enemies.

=== Heroes: Alarak ===
[Bug Fixes]
  • Fixed an issue that caused Alarak's Lightning Surge to display incorrectly at long range.
  • Fixed an issue that caused Last Laugh to heal when they have been granted Spell leech. (Example: Nano Infusion from Ana)

=== Heroes: Ana ===
[Bug Fixes]
  • Fixed an issue that caused Eye of Horus to hit Invulnerable Heroes.

=== Heroes: Anduin ===
[Bug Fixes]
  • Divine Star Sword will no longer be destroyed when leaving the base during the game start period.
  • Fixed an issue that caused Piercing Light to treat the first hit as the second.

=== Heroes: Anub'arak ===
[Bug Fixes]
  • Anubarak's Burning Beetle damage is now affected by all forms of damage modification.
  • No longer able to use Locust Swarm while riding on the Toy Train.
  • Updating cancel animations of Hardened Shields to be like similar visuals.

=== Heroes: Artanis ===
[User Interface]
  • [Undocumented] Damage against Heroes prevented by Blinds now contributes to Healing/Shielding done.
[Bug Fixes]
  • Fixed an issue that caused Target Purified to deal double damage.
  • Fixed an issue that caused Titan Killer being capable of damaging Invulnerable targets when activated from Twin Blades.
  • Updated visuals of Spell Armor.

=== Heroes: Arthas ===
[Bug Fixes]
  • Legion of Northrend's bonus healing is now additive.
  • Rime now has a Block visual.

=== Heroes: Auriel ===
[User Interface]
  • [Undocumented] Damage against Heroes prevented by Blinds now contributes to Healing/Shielding done.
[Bug Fixes]
  • Fixed an issue that caused Searing Light to not grant energy when hitting a Protected enemy.

=== Heroes: Azmodan ===
[Bug Fixes]
  • Bombardment will no longer attack inactive Mercenaries unless the attack is against an inactive Mercenary.
  • ~~Fixed an issue that caused Azmodan's Demon Warriors to leave permanent burning visuals if killed at the same moment they spawn.~~
  • Fixed an issue that caused Tide of Sin to leave visual markers at place of death.
  • Fixed Globe of Annihilation no longer stacking off of Possessed minions.
  • No longer possible to cast Tide of Sin when it is already active.

=== Heroes: Blaze ===
[Bug Fixes]
  • Fixed an issue that caused Blaze to deal bonus damage to enemies hit by another Blaze's Flame Streams.

=== Heroes: Brightwing ===
[Bug Fixes]
  • Fixed an issue that caused Phase Shift to activate on the previous target.
  • [Undocumented] Fixed an issue that caused Brightwing to not face the target while casting Phase Shift via fuzzy targeting.

=== Heroes: Cassia ===
[User Interface]
  • [Undocumented] Damage against Heroes prevented by Blinds now contributes to Healing/Shielding done.
[Bug Fixes]
  • Updating cancel animations of Hardened Shields to be like similar visuals.

=== Heroes: Chen ===
[Bug Fixes]
  • Fixed an issue that caused Stagger to heal when they have been granted Spell leech. (Example: Nano Infusion from Ana)

=== Heroes: Cho ===
[Bug Fixes]
  • Fixed an issue that caused Enraged Regeneration to display incorrectly in the Death Recap.

=== Heroes: D.Va ===
[Bug Fixes]
  • Fixed an issue that caused Liquid Cooling to reset the fountain in ARAM incorrectly.
  • Pilot Mode can now see the Self-Destruct charge.
  • Fixed an issue that caused Nuclear Option to trigger on an already exploded Mech.
  • Micro Missiles no longer hits Invulnerable targets.
  • [Undocumented] Fixed an issue causing D.Va's Diverting Power to display as Defense Matrix in the Death Recap.

=== Heroes: Deathwing ===
[Bug Fixes]
  • Added Bellowing Roar Camera Lock.

=== Heroes: Deckard ===
[Bug Fixes]
  • Fixed an issue that caused Ancient Blessings damage to not scale on targets if they level up while it is active.
  • Included Potion to search text for Deckard.

=== Heroes: Dehaka ===
[Bug Fixes]
  • Updated visuals of Spell Armor.

=== Heroes: ETC ===
[Bug Fixes]
  • Crowd Surfer now displays floating text for mana refund.

=== Heroes: Falstad ===
[Bug Fixes]
  • Fixed an issue that caused Falstad's Flight warning indicator to no longer display after selecting Epic Mount.
  • Fixed an issue that caused Sustained Winds to damage invulnerable targets.

=== Heroes: Gall ===
[Bug Fixes]
  • Fixed an issue that caused Enraged Regeneration to display incorrectly in the Death Recap.

=== Heroes: Garrosh ===
[Bug Fixes]
  • Unrivaled Strength bonus is now additive.

=== Heroes: Gazlowe ===
[Bug Fixes]
  • Fixed an issue that caused Xplodium Bomb to not be affected by allied cooldown reduction.

=== Heroes: Genji ===
[Bug Fixes]
  • Fixed an issue that caused Strike at the Heart to not display a damage preview.
  • Swift Strike now displays floating text for mana refund.
  • Updated visuals of Spell Armor.

=== Heroes: Hanzo ===
[Bug Fixes]
  • Ignore All Distractions will now display MISSED! text in the case of Blinds.

=== Heroes: Hogger ===
[Bug Fixes]
  • Fixed an issue that caused Hogger's Hogg Wild visual to [Undocumented] not be visible when Hogger is visible.

=== Heroes: Imperius ===
[Bug Fixes]
  • Fixed an issue that caused Brightwing and Falstad to be at the incorrect height after Celestial Charge Stuns them and a least one other Hero.

=== Heroes: Jaina ===
[Bug Fixes]
  • Water Elemental Frostbolts will now behave consistently with Jaina's Frostbolts.

=== Heroes: Johanna ===
[User Interface]
  • [Undocumented] Damage against Heroes prevented by Blinds now contributes to Healing/Shielding done.

=== Heroes: Junkrat ===
[Bug Fixes]
  • Chattering Teeth will now chase (but not trap) Invulnerable targets.
  • Fixed an issued that caused Chattering Teeth to apply to Arming Steel Traps when selected.

=== Heroes: Kerrigan ===
[Bug Fixes]
  • Fixed an issue that caused Sharpened Blades to stack off of Possessed minions.
  • Included Infested to search text for Kerrigan.

=== Heroes: Leoric ===
[Bug Fixes]
  • Skeletal Swing mana refund now displays as a crit.

=== Heroes: Li Li ===
[User Interface]
  • [Undocumented] Damage against Heroes prevented by Blinds now contributes to Healing/Shielding done.
[Updates]
  Base:
  • Jug of 1,000 Cups
    • Healing amount increased from 66 to ~~80~~ 75 .

=== Heroes: Li-Ming ===
[Bug Fixes]
  • Fixed an issue if Seeker is slected while Magic Missiles are in flight while Force Armor was selected.
  • Fixed an issue that caused Force Armor to grant multiple stacks from the same Magic Missiles cast.

=== Heroes: Lunara ===
[Bug Fixes]
  • Splintered Spear will no longer attack inactive Mercenaries unless the triggering attack is against an inactive Mercenary.
  • Fixed an issue that caused Splintered Spear to not display correctly while Blinded or against an Evading enemy.
  • [Undocumented] Lunara's Splitered Spear will now display as its own effect in the Death Recap, instead of as a Basic Attack.

=== Heroes: Lúcio ===
[Bug Fixes]
  • Fixed an issue that caused Sound Barrier shields to not decay if Bossa Nova was slected while the target was shielded.

=== Heroes: Maiev ===
[Bug Fixes]
  • Naisha's Memento first bounce can now bounce to inactive Mercenaries if the triggering attack is against an inactive Mercenary.

=== Heroes: Mal'Ganis ===
[Bug Fixes]
  • Included Vampire to search text for Mal'Ganis.

=== Heroes: Medivh ===
[Updates]
  Talents:
  • Level 4
    • Mage Armor
      • Duration increased from 4 to ~~6~~ 5 seconds.
      • Armor amount increased from 30 to ~~50~~ 40 .
[Bug Fixes]
  • Medivh's Portal is now an invalid target for allied Abilities. (Example: Brightwing's Blink Heal)

=== Heroes: Mei ===
[User Interface]
  • [Undocumented] Damage against Heroes prevented by Blinds now contributes to Healing/Shielding done.
[Bug Fixes]
  • Fixed an issue where The Big One was not gaining the full benefit of Slushball.

=== Heroes: Mephisto ===
[Bug Fixes]
  • Fixed an issue that caused Unspeakable Horror being temporarily disabled when the target is knocked back.

=== Heroes: Murky ===
[Bug Fixes]
  • Egg Hunt Egg is no longer killed in one hit by Structures.
  • Fixed an issue that caused Fishy Deal to stack off of Possessed minions.

=== Heroes: Nazeebo ===
[Bug Fixes]
  • Fixed an issue that caused Voodoo Ritual to stack off of Possessed minions.

=== Heroes: Nova ===
[Updates]
  Talents:
  • Level 1
    • Advanced Cloaking
      • Mana Regeneration increased from 3 to 6.
  • Level 7
    • Anti-Armor Shells
      • Armor reduction duration increased from 3 to ~~5~~ 4 seconds.
[Bug Fixes]
  • Fixed an issue that caused Holo Decoy's Health bars to display incorrectly after losing Protected.

=== Heroes: Orphea ===
[Bug Fixes]
  • Fixed an issue that caused Ravenous Hunger to stack off of Possessed minions.
  • Fixed an issue that caused Shadow Waltz to refund mana multiple times per cast.

=== Heroes: Probius ===
[Bug Fixes]
  • Fixed an issue that caused Spawning Minerals off of Possessed minions.
  • Included Builder to search text for Probius.

=== Heroes: Qhira ===
[Bug Fixes]
  • Updated visuals of Spell Armor.

=== Heroes: Ragnaros ===
[Bug Fixes]
  • Fixed an issue that caused Sulfuras Hungers to stack off of Possessed minions.
  • Updated visuals of Spell Armor.

=== Heroes: Raynor ===
[Bug Fixes]
  • Execute Orders now displays in the Death Recap for its Hyperion cast.

=== Heroes: Rehgar ===
[Bug Fixes]
  • Improved Death Recap for Hunger of the Wolf.

=== Heroes: Samuro ===
[Bug Fixes]
  • Mirage now functions like other Spell Armor Blocks.

=== Heroes: Sgt. Hammer ===
[Bug Fixes]
  • Fixed an issue that caused Orbital BFG to not be affected by damage reduction.
  • Pulse Detonation Core will replace Spider Mines in the recap if chosen.
  • Spider Mines damage is now modified by Defense Matrix and Ultimate Evolution damage modifications.
  • Spider Mines duration will continue while they are chasing.
  • ~~Spider Mines will no longer detonate on Invulnerable targets but will continue to chase them.~~
  • Spider Mines will now display their damage when clicked in the Target Info Panel.

=== Heroes: Stitches ===
[Bug Fixes]
  • Fixed an issue that caused Putrefaction to display floating text multiple times at once.

=== Heroes: Stukov ===
[Bug Fixes]
  • Fixed an issue that caused Weighted Pustule to not display a damage preview.

=== Heroes: Sylvanas ===
[Bug Fixes]
  • Fixed an issue that caused Withering Fire to display incorrectly.

=== Heroes: Tassadar ===
[Bug Fixes]
  • Fixed an issue where Twilight Archon could use Toy Train.
  • Khaydarin Amulet will cancel itself if the target is an inactive Mercenary.

=== Heroes: The Butcher ===
[Bug Fixes]
  • Fixed an issue that caused Butcher's Fresh Meat spawning meat off of Possessed minions.

=== Heroes: The Lost Vikings ===
[Bug Fixes]
  • Fixed an issue that caused Nordic Attack Squad to be able to damage invulnerable targets.
  • Fixed an issue where there health was not set to full on death.

=== Heroes: Thrall ===
[Bug Fixes]
  • Fixed an issue that caused Echo of the Elements activating off of Possessed Minions and Hallucinations.
  • Fixed an issue that caused Rolling Thunder to not activate from Tempest Fury's attacks.
  • Fixed an issue that caused Wolf Pack to reset Feral Spirit on talent reset incorrectly.

=== Heroes: Tracer ===
[Bug Fixes]
  • Fixed an issue that caused Get Stuffed to be capable of knocking back a target multiple times when Melee was cast in quick succession.
  • Fixed an issue that caused Get Stuffed to knock back targets with other Heroes' Pulse Bombs placed on them.
  • Locked and Loaded will now cause Tracer's Basic Attacks to display as Criticals when active.
  • Ricochet can now bounce to inactive Mercenaries if the attack is against an inactive Mercenary.

=== Heroes: Valeera ===
[User Interface]
  • [Undocumented] Damage against Heroes prevented by Blinds now contributes to Healing/Shielding done.

=== Heroes: Whitemane ===
[Bug Fixes]
  • Included Chapeau to search text for Whitemane.

=== Heroes: Zagara ===
[Bug Fixes]
  • Medusa Blades will no longer attack inactive Mercenaries unless the triggering attack is against an inactive Mercenary.
  • Mutalisk first bounce can now bounce to inactive Mercenaries if the attack is against an inactive Mercenary.

=== Heroes: Zarya ===
[Bug Fixes]
  • Fixed an issue that caused Basic Attacks not being affected properly by attack speed modifiers.

[Bug Fixes]
  • Fixed an issue that caused Might of the Nerazim abilities to heal for more damage than intended with Shadow Mending.

=== Heroes: Zul'jin ===
[Bug Fixes]
  • A Surprise For Ya! can now bounce to inactive Mercenaries if the attack is against an inactive Mercenary.
